items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: playing with Herve Sellin and Alvin Queen, the trio

ctx.x: I like it very much because you are playing with Herve Sellin and Alvin Queen, the trio. You performed a lot in the 90s with, especially Alvin Queen.
